card.name: Where a drug goes in the body
card.fires_on: Words in administration instructions that name a route or body site, such as 'into', 'in', 'front', 'side' after a verb like apply, inject or deliver. Also fires on odd pieces of words in the same setting, such as 'Inst<<ill>>'.

modes.label: Route and site words
modes.description: Small direction or location words in directions for where to put a drug or fluid.
modes.example: Apply one or two drops of LOTEPREDNOL ETABONATE and TOBRAMYCIN ophthalmic suspension<< into>> the conjunctival sac of the affected

modes.label: Body-part positions
modes.description: Words naming the part of a limb or area used for an injection.
modes.example: Inject into the<< front>> of the thigh or abdomen. The back

modes.label: Handling verbs and word pieces
modes.description: Action words or word pieces in delivery steps, such as instilling or pumping a solution.
modes.example: Inst<<ill>> one drop in the affected eye(s)

card.plain: It lights up on small words in directions that say where or how a drug is put into the body.
